description: A compact current-period summary of your org's usage (totals as of now, from the daily rollup). No parameters. Use for a quick 'how much have I used so far'; use spicrawl_usage for a windowed breakdown. Requires the `read` scope.
name: spicrawl_usage_summary

allowance.description: The monthly allowance the API enforces. Omitted when it cannot be read (warnings says so).

remaining_micro.description: Credits left under the monthly limit: the number to show.

resets_at.description: When the allowance is restored in full.

used_micro.description: Spent plus credits held for in-flight work.

used_basis_points.description: Used / included in basis points (10000 = 100%); null when nothing is included.

used_micro.description: Credits spent so far, from the usage rollup; excludes credits held for in-flight work.

credits.description: Metered usage against the plan's included credits. Micro-credits: 1 credit = 1000000.

metrics.description: Every billed metric for the period.

period.description: The window, as a half-open range of UTC days.

period_elapsed_days.description: Whole days of the period elapsed; use it to pace consumption.

subscription_status.description: 'none' when no subscription covers now (the free plan).

stale_seconds.description: Age of usage_as_of in seconds; null when the window is empty. A large value means the rollup is behind.

unattributed.description: Metric name -> quantity. credits are micro-credits (1 credit = 1000000), engine_ms milliseconds, bytes_* bytes, the rest counts.

usage_as_of.description: When the newest rollup row in the window was written; null when the window is empty.

warnings.description: Caveats the numbers would otherwise hide.

title: Usage summary
